reviewContext.userProblem: Replace visible CodeMirror DOM rendering with GPU canvas text, cursor, selection and feedback while preserving editor behavior. Design, plan, implement and verify browser WASM integration, a concrete iPad integration path, audio-clock synchronization and bounded visual resources.
requiredOutcomes: Reviewed design documents GPU text architecture, browser/native iPad integration, accessibility, synchronization, resource lifetime, measurable budgets and risks.
Reviewed code-free file-level plans record invariants, dependencies, behavioral verification and completion progress.
GPU canvas renders text, cursor, selection, syntax, evaluation, diagnostics and playing highlights while existing interactions remain functional.
Evidence covers Japanese IME, clipboard, undo/redo, keyboard/touch selection, scrolling, resizing and high DPI.
Timestamped audio/transport time, revision-aware mapping and output-latency compensation support late-frame recovery without accumulated drift.
Reviewed visual scope includes video, synth effects, oscilloscopes and beat displays.
Bounded reusable glyph, geometry, buffer and queue resources have measured rendering, input and memory evidence under concurrent audio/visual load.
Browser WASM and buildable iPad integration components are verified; unavailable physical-device checks remain incomplete.
Independent review, improve self-review, material fixes, progress updates and authorized Git finalization are delivered.
nonGoals: No second editor engine, new language coupling, raw GLSL interface, browser taps, per-slot audio mixing or AUv3.
No camera, microphone, streaming service or new Swift UI.
No extra worktrees, PR creation, third-party messaging or unrelated changes.
constraints: Visible code must use GPU canvas rendering; DOM bridges may serve input and accessibility.
Preserve all recorded dirty files; never stage unrelated MusicDSP or rumble work.
Task-owned commits and non-force pushes are explicitly authorized; no extra worktrees, PR creation or third-party messaging.
Accepted-plan commit and non-force push precede implementation fanout.
Use design-doc and impl-plan skills; explicit code-free planning requirements override skill examples containing code.
Use rust-coding and check-and-test-after-modify agents for Rust modifications; split touched Rust files at 1000 or more lines unless explicitly excluded.
Keep audio independent of rendering; make no hard real-time display or universal zero-copy claims.
Measure budgets on named hardware; never infer iPad evidence from unit tests.
Run commands in the foreground, retain session handles until exit, and record complete logs and final statuses.
Use CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and failure-focused nextest environment variables.
Each worker owns only its plan progress log; never edit this shared manifest. Shared indexes, archive and broad formatting are serial CE-FINAL work; initial locks belong CE-PACKAGE.
Evidence logs use tmp/canvas-editor-224/<planId>/<attempt>/; immutable edit snapshots also follow the execution contract.

Continuation manifest excludes committed CE-CONTRACT/CE-STATE/CE-INPUT from plans[]. Native dispatcher projects external predecessor edges; acceptedPlanIds in worker messages describes remaining dispatched IDs only. Consume external contracts from this reviewed context and committed source proof, not invented accepted flags. If proof drifts, serial coordinator restores evidence-only admission for affected owner before dependent work.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Retain headless CodeMirror state and revision authority; migrate all EditorView consumers coherently while WebGL2 renders visible source and feedback.
Shape visible runs offscreen and reuse bounded atlas tiles and GPU geometry; retain CPU editing state across context loss.
Use timestamped epoch/revision-aware transport and audible output correlation, without double-counting latency; late frames recover from absolute time.
Reuse GlRenderHost and analyzers; compose one muted local video and synth outputs through an explicit bounded canvas copy.
Retain browser Rust/WASM ABI; native IPC and shared Rust bootstrap use existing CPAL host with limited iOS audio-session glue.
intentionalTradeoffs: No hard real-time display or universal zero-copy guarantee.
DOM bridge serves input and accessibility while source stays GPU-rendered.
Unavailable device, manual IME/accessibility and physical synchronization evidence remains incomplete; desktop builds cannot replace iPad evidence.
supportedEdgeCases: Composition commit/cancel and deferred source writes; clipboard, undo/redo, graphemes, CRLF and tabs.
Revision/epoch changes, stale spans, telemetry overflow, late frames, pause and lost correlation.
Scroll, DPR/resize, touch selection, context loss and restore, allocation refusal, hidden video and disposal.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Mixed RTL support requires explicit visual-order evidence; report unsupported cases as a limitation.
Documents above the measured 1 MiB profile have unverified performance.
Native visual-language programs unsupported by host capabilities report diagnostics.
